rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when demonstrating that something is true or evident.

example.english: These figures demonstrate that the method really works.
example.traditional: 呢啲數據足以證明個方法真係有效。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sou3 geoi3 zuk1 ji5 zing3 ming4 go3 fong1 faat3 zan1 hai6 jau5 haau6

rows.note: Use this when deliberately displaying or presenting something rather than proving a claim.

example.english: I’ll demonstrate this new product for you now.
example.traditional: 我而家展示吓呢款新產品畀你睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zin2 si6 haa5 ni1 fun2 san1 caan2 ban2 bei2 nei5 tai2

rows.note: Use this when showing someone how to use or do something.

example.english: I’ll demonstrate how to use this machine.
example.traditional: 我而家示範一次畀你睇點樣用呢部機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 si6 faan6 jat1 ci3 bei2 nei5 tai2 dim2 joeng2 jung6 ni1 bou6 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for taking part in or organizing a public protest.

example.english: Several groups will demonstrate in Central tomorrow.
example.traditional: 聽日有幾個團體喺中環示威。
example.jyutping: teng1 jat6 jau5 gei2 go3 tyun4 tai2 hai2 zung1 waan4 si6 wai1
